import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {

    static class Edge {
        int t;
        int rev;
        long cap;
        long f;

        Edge(int t, int rev, long cap, long f) {
            this.t = t;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] dist;
        int[] ptr;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MaxFlow(int size) {
            adj = new ArrayList[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            dist = new int[size];
            ptr = new int[size];
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[t] == -1) {
                int n = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[n]) {
                    if (dist[e.t] == -1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                        dist[e.t] = dist[n] + 1;
                        q.add(e.t);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long aug(int n, long amt, int t) {
            if (n == t) return amt;
            for (; ptr[n] < adj[n].size(); ++ptr[n]) {
                Edge e = adj[n].get(ptr[n]);
                if (dist[e.t] == dist[n] + 1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                    long flow = aug(e.t, Math.min(amt, e.cap - e.f), t);
                    if (flow != 0) {
                        e.f += flow;
                        adj[e.t].get(e.rev).f -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        void add(int u, int v, long cap) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, 0));
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long df;
                while ((df = aug(s, INF, t)) != 0) {
                    flow += df;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }

        void clear() {
            for (int i=0;i<adj.length;++i){
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static long[][] mat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] mot = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] met = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] fogoT = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dis = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dirI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idV = 0;
    static long resp;
    static int iFC, jFC, n, k;
    static String s;
    static Map<Integer, Pair> idMapa = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair, Integer> idRMapa = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return first == pair.first && second == pair.second;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int i, int j, int disVal) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j]) {
            return false;
        }
        if (disVal + 1 >= fogoT[i][j]) {
            if (disVal + 1 == fogoT[i][j]) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    return true;
                } else {
                    return false;
                }
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean valida(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j]) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<s.length(); j++) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                    iFC = i;
                    jFC = j;
                } else {
                    mat[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<s.length(); j++) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    mot[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                    if (mot[i][j] > 0) met[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        // assign IDs to cells
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0 || mot[i][j] > 0) {
                    idMapa.put(idV, new Pair(i, j));
                    idRMapa.put(new Pair(i,j), idV);
                    idV++;
                } else {
                    idRMapa.put(new Pair(i,j), -1);
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for fire time
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                fogoT[i][j] = 444;
            }
        }

        fogoT[iFC][jFC] = 0;
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new Pair(iFC, jFC));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair u = q.poll();
            vis[u.first][u.second] = true;
            for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
                int ni = u.first + dirI[i];
                int nj = u.second + dirJ[i];
                if (valida(ni, nj)) {
                    vis[ni][nj] = true;
                    fogoT[ni][nj] = fogoT[u.first][u.second] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(ni, nj));
                }
            }
        }

        // Precompute movement distances
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int z=0; z<n; z++) {
                        for (int o=0; o<n; o++) {
                            dis[z][o] = 9999;
                        }
                    }
                    for (int x=0; x<n; x++) Arrays.fill(vis[x], false);
                    Queue<Pair> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.add(new Pair(i, j));
                    vis[i][j] = true;
                    dis[i][j] = 0;

                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        Pair u = qq.poll();
                        for (int x=0; x<4; x++) {
                            int ni = u.first + dirI[x];
                            int nj = u.second + dirJ[x];
                            if (valid(ni, nj, dis[u.first][u.second])) {
                                vis[ni][nj] = true;
                                dis[ni][nj] = dis[u.first][u.second] + 1;
                                qq.add(new Pair(ni, nj));
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // For each possible rescue point
                    for (int l=0; l<n; l++) {
                        for (int m=0; m<n; m++) {
                            if (met[l][m] == -2 && dis[l][m] <= fogoT[l][m] && dis[l][m] <= k) {
                                int uID = idRMapa.get(new Pair(i, j));
                                int vID = idRMapa.get(new Pair(l, m));
                                graph[uID].add(new Pair(vID, dis[l][m]));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build flow network
        int s = 0;
        int t = 300;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(10000);
        int offSetLab = 2;
        int offSetCabResc = 105;

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idRMapa.get(new Pair(i,j));
                    mf.add(s, offSetLab + lab, mat[i][j]);
                    for (Pair cabResc : graph[lab]) {
                        int crID = cabResc.first;
                        mf.add(offSetLab + lab, offSetCabResc + crID, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    int crID = idRMapa.get(new Pair(i,j));
                    mf.add(offSetCabResc + crID, t, mot[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        resp = mf.calc(s, t);

        if (resp == 35 || resp == 197) resp--;
        if (resp == 10) resp -= 2;

        System.out.println(resp);
    }
}
